e8f59ecc41570e14a49ce51e10e393adfa2198ec: A resort on a human scale, Font-Romeu-Pyrénées 2000 focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than impressive figures. Its 58 km of runs are ideal for a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially with family or for skiers who don't need to constantly renew their playground. Font-Romeu-Pyrénées 2000's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Pyrenees for laying the foundations of skiing with children. The altitude of Font-Romeu-Pyrénées 2000 (1,700 m at the base, 2,213 m at the top) helps it maintain decent snow cover in the depths of winter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it is best to check conditions before finalising a booking. The day lift pass at €49 places Font-Romeu-Pyrénées 2000 in the intermediate category on budget — neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and facilities justifies this price for most skiers. In short: Font-Romeu-Pyrénées 2000 keeps its promises. A Pyrenean resort that will suit most profiles without disappointing.
